tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public football stories by keywords. Returns canonical links, reporting labels, source citations and timestamps.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a public story by its 24-character story ID. Returns the same brief available to readers; no full publisher article.

tools.name: list_clubs
tools.description: List clubs with published coverage and their stable slugs.

tools.name: get_fixtures
tools.description: Read cached public fixtures and results, optionally for one club. Updated timestamps indicate freshness.

tools.name: get_transfers
tools.description: Read public transfer room summaries, reporting labels and linked story context.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
